questions: what is the project name, or are there multiple projects?
who are the responsible people or decision-makers involved in this project?
what problem or need motivates this architecture or these changes?
what alternatives were considered to solve this problem, and why were they discarded?
what trade-offs or consequences, positive and negative, were accepted with the decision taken?
what constraints (technical, business, compliance, cost, or timeline) shaped this decision?
which components interact with each other, and what data do they exchange?
which components are new, which are evolving, which are unchanged, and which are being removed or deprecated?
which discipline owns each component: software engineering, data engineering, or frontend engineering?
what data contracts exist between components, and what fields, format, or frequency do they define?
what is the status of the decision: proposed, accepted, in development, or already in production?
what SLA or non-functional expectations does each component have?
what is the purpose or responsibility of each component mentioned?
what risks did participants mention about this decision or architecture?
what assumptions are being made that, if wrong, would invalidate this decision?
